details.detail: Sidewall panels and seams. Unchanged from w12 (s01 diff 0.7). Clean seams every second window, with no gaps. Still plain satin where tt_window shows a fine weave.

F/J short bowls and LED pill. The bowl shape and pane placement match omaat_room24 and tt_window. The pill now measures 0.088 of the pane width (photo 0.094) and reads as a bolder ring with two halves.

PY/Y full-height tubs and raised bezel. Pixel-identical to w12 at the tub. The tub aspect (~0.40, against ~0.42) and pane centre (0.54 of the tub, against 0.54) still match sp_py14. The lip band is lighting's. A faint light card remains on the tub floor.
Pane tunnel lining and seal. Unchanged and right (s09, ra_jWin).

Electric shades. The blackout is now 0.61 of the wall, warm taupe (B-R -13), and reads as one with omaat_room24 / room38 in tone. Far shades are clean, with no beat bands. The close-up pleats read as thin dark ruled lines on a flat crest (valley ~25 % of the period). In room24 the shaded lower pleat face covers ~50 % of the period, at cv 0.35 against ours 0.17. The sheer is unchanged and right.
Manual PY/Y shades (s08, win_front). Unchanged; the half and stowed states read right against sp_py24.

Dado, grilles and placards. The slate dado and the grille layout per bay are right (win_low, b_dadoY2). The louvres are almost invisible: in win_low the horizontal louvre ripple is 117-122 (cv ~0.02), against py_37303 crisp light lips on dark slots (cv 0.45). The vertical ribs are more prominent than the louvres (7 per grille against ~3 in the photo). The dado reads 0.56 of the wall in b_dadoY2 against 0.45.

Floors. The Y carpet is unchanged at (44,54,77), the right navy. The vinyl is now warm-neutral (106,102,104), B-R -2 (sans_09 about -3). The fine speckle is still half the photo's (L std 12.5 against ~24).

Type A door surround and viewing window. The layout matches lalf_133/134. The window aspect has improved to 0.48, with a light rim. The window is undersized, though: in lalf_133 (near face-on) the bezel is ~0.22 of the door width and ~1.4x the height of the arm-arc box, with its bottom level with the assist bar. In s06 it is ~0.19 of the door width and ~1.0x the box height, ending at the box bottom. The 20 mm tab does not read as the photo's partly drawn shade with its finger slot.

issues.detail: Door viewing window undersized; tab is not the photo's partly drawn shade
issues.problem: The aspect is now right (0.48), but the linear size is ~0.75 of the photo's. In lalf_133 the window bezel spans ~1.4x the arm-arc box height and runs from just above the box top down to the assist-bar level. Ours equals the box height (s06: window rows 288-357, box 285-350, bar 383). lalf_133/134 show the glass with a cream shade pulled ~25-30 % down and a dark horizontal finger slot. Ours has a 20 mm strip at the top edge.
issues.evidence: rb13/lalf133_door.png (door panel x 60-330, window bezel x 245-305, y 215-350; arc box y 235-330) against w13/sh/s06_door2L.png. rb13/doorwin_cmp.png.
issues.fix: 07_shell.js door cell: windowCellPattern(cellW, 0.26, 0.58, 0.055, ...) with the centre lowered ~0.05 so the bottom meets the assist-bar height. The glass S scale follows (0.68*0.26, 0.69*0.58). Check that cellW 0.50 still clears the housing rim; if not, cellW 0.54. Replace the 0.10 x 0.02 tab with a cream gRBox(0.68*0.26, 0.16, 0.006) shade panel at the top of the glass, plus a dark 0.05 x 0.008 slot (WMAT.pin) 0.02 above its lower edge.

issues.detail: Dado air-return grille louvres almost invisible
issues.problem: py_37303 shows crisp horizontal louvres (light lips on dark slots, cv 0.45) with ~3 faint vertical ribs. Ours reads as flat slate with ~7 stronger vertical ribs and a louvre ripple of 5 grey levels (cv ~0.02). At aisle distance the grilles read as plain dark panels.
issues.evidence: rb13/photo_grille.png against rb13/grille_studio.png (win_low col 180: 117/122 alternating). b_dadoY2 grille row 515 is 30-54.
issues.fix: 07_shell.js grille builder: give each louvre a lit top lip (lighter vertex colour x1.5, or a 45-degree slat normal) and a dark slot (x0.5), about 6 mm pitch. Cut the vertical ribs to 3 per grille and soften them.

issues.detail: Blackout pleat valleys read as thin ruled lines on a flat crest
issues.problem: The valley line is ~25 % of the pleat period. In omaat_room24 the shaded lower face of each pleat covers ~45-55 % of the period, so the shade reads 3-D folded, not ruled. Near cv 0.17 against 0.35. This now matches room38 at mid distance, so it is minor.
issues.evidence: rb13/pleat_cmp.png (w12 | w13 | room24). b_jClose col 300: 92-101 valley, 160-164 crest, period 8.5 px.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py s_pleat: widen the dark band to ~40 % of the period with a soft ramp (crest 1.0 -> lower face 0.62 -> valley line 0.5) in place of a thin line. Keep the mip chain, and keep the mean the same by lifting the crest slightly.

issues.problem: There is no fine linen weave, which tt_window shows at seat distance.
The hue is fixed, but L std is 12.5 against ~24 in sans_09.
issues.fix: Shared 03_tex.js LAYER_PARAMS vinyl (layer 7) speckle amplitude x1.6, one line.

notes: w13 against w12 (commit 23c5d63). Pixel diffs with w12 confirm that the shell changes are confined to the shades, door window, pill, vinyl and b_dadoY2. The big diffs in ra_carpetY, q14 and q16 are seats (other areas), and the carpet pixels are unchanged. Every w12 change helped, and none regressed. The moire is gone (beat std 30 -> 4). Blackout tone and hue now match omaat_room24 (0.61 of the wall, B-R -13). The pill and vinyl hue are within tolerance. Door window aspect went from 0.41 to 0.48, with a light rim. No high or medium issues. The geometry-first pass found one new low: the door viewing window is ~0.75 of the photo's linear size (lalf_133, near face-on). The grille louvre contrast is a new detail finding. The score moves from 8.4 to 8.5. Crops are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/749d4d84-e5c3-5607-b504-f60325623e45/scratchpad/rb13/.
